column1: # Upstream components of motanka-apps: the programs of Upstream's base
# package list that the Ubuntu archives do not have and that cannot be
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there). Installed
# unchanged by packaging/motanka-apps/debian/rules, for both suites.
#   herdr  herdr 0.9.5 (Apache-2.0), the version Upstream's PKGBUILD pins:
#          the project's x86_64 release binary herdr-linux-x86_64 (30285672
#          bytes; the release has no tarballs). Build "file": stack/fetch-
#          sources packs it as herdr/herdr-linux-x86_64 into the orig
#          component herdr. It is not built from source because its
#          ghostty-vt crate compiles libghostty-vt with Zig, which neither
#          release has. SHA-256 from GitHub's published digest of the asset.
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/apps-components.tsv
